Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses BROAD BASED QUALITATIVE REQUIREMENT (BBQR) BBQR SPECIFICATION OF CMA 750K MICROARRAY SERVICE FOR SERVICE BIDDING Technical Specifications – CMA 750K :- · The test offered shall be Chromosomal Microarray Analysis (CMA) 750K. · The platform shall have a minimum probe density of ≥ 750,000 probes. · The system shall provide whole-genome coverage, including clinically relev ant regions. · The copy number detection resolution shall be ≤ 50 kb. · The assay shall be capable of detecting copy number variations (CNVs), a neuploidies, regions of loss of heterozygosity (LOH), and mosaicism. · The test shall be compatible with genomic DNA from blood, tissue, and p renatal samples. · The maximum DNA input requirement shall be ≤ 250 ng. · The platform shall be a microarray-based CMA system using GeneChip™ System 3000 or equivalent. · Data analysis shall be performed using Chromosome Analysis Suite (ChAS ) software or equivalent. · The system shall support single-sample as well as batch-sample processing. · The final clinical report shall be ISCN-compliant. Facility, Accreditation & Compliance :- · Testing shall be performed in an in-house laboratory facility with valid in stallation certification for the platform. · The laboratory shall be NABL accredited as per ISO 15189. · The laboratory shall possess a valid DSIR certification. · The platform and workflow shall be compatible with NABL / ISO 15189 re quirements. · The platform shall be clinically validated for intended use. · Complete documentation, including user manuals, quality control procedure s, and validation data, shall be provided.
· The vendor’s operational facility shall be located in Pune. .
